claim: Development-only Winter et al. (2020) Stage 3 baseline wrapper. Method semantics transcribed from the Winter prototype under references/winter_2020_model_check/model_check/lib (read-only provenance; code is re-implemented, not imported). Not a formal result; formal completion blocked on S1.7 and S2.13.

method.source: references/winter_2020_model_check/model_check/lib (main.py, classes/Pair.py, classes/Process.py, classes/Paragraph.py, classes/Sentence.py, classes/Clause.py, classes/SimilarityComputer.py, classes/Flow.py, classes/Document_Collection.py, functions.py)
method.semantics: For every (BPMN model, regulation paragraph) pair: map every paragraph obligation clause to the maximally similar model obligation (spaCy en_core_web_sm .similarity on lemmatized text); fitness = mean similarity of mappings above gamma; obligation cost = fraction of clauses without a matching model obligation above gamma (missing action); resource cost = fraction of clauses whose matched task is similar (>gamma) but whose mentioned resource/actor is not the model participant (spaCy similarity < delta and no exact textual match) (incorrect actor); so (sequence/order) cost = fraction of paragraph flows whose condition matches and whose obligation task is reachable from the compared task but not vice versa (out of order).

prediction_rules.matching_relevant: fitness > 0 (a paragraph obligation maps to a model obligation with similarity > gamma); no extra threshold invented
prediction_rules.violation_type: cost_X > 0 for X in {obligation, resource, so}; no extra threshold invented

known_prototype_deviation: is_reachable_from(sourceid, targetid) in Process.py returns 'targetid in reachability[targetid]' (always True). This is a deterministic code bug: it makes the 'not reachable back' conjunct always False and hence out-of-order cost always 0. Re-implemented as 'targetid in reachability[sourceid]' and disclosed; without the fix the out_of_order baseline would be vacuous.

resource (incorrect-actor) detection depends on the BPMN participant/process name attribute; the frozen GDPR7 BPMN files carry an empty process name (and empty lane names), so resource cost is expected to be vacuous on this data; disclosed as an input-contract limitation.

The prototype evaluates every regulation article against every model; this wrapper runs only the 25 matching pairs and 33 violation points frozen in the S3.2/S3.3 correction pack (input binding), so support matches the frozen Gold.

bpmn_membership_contract.purpose: frozen S3.1 all-seven GDPR BPMN membership

gold_annotation_blank_pack.purpose: 58 frozen candidates (25 matching + 33 violation) with embedded rule_text; contains NO decisions, so the runner cannot read Gold

winter_lexicon_dir.role: EXTERNAL read-only provenance dependency, NOT copied into formal_experiment/: signalwords.txt (constraint detection), sequencemarkers.txt (flow detection), stopwords.txt (lemmatization filtering)

external_dependencies.note: development run is NOT fully self-contained inside formal_experiment/; the Winter lexicon and the spaCy model are external runtime prerequisites

spacy_model.note: same model family as the Winter prototype; no download, no network

reachability_modes.corrected_reachability: default development main version; fixes the prototype always-True is_reachable_from bug
reachability_modes.prototype_literal: zero-cost sensitivity mode replicating the prototype's literal buggy expression

evaluator.note: no compliant (none) gold items exist in the frozen violation pack, so specificity/compliant accuracy is N/A
